plainTranslation:
This connection may not announce itself as loudly as the conjunction or square, but there is something here that responds when one of you reaches for it. The warmth grows when someone checks in, speaks honestly, follows through, or shows care in a way the other person can actually feel.

This is a contact where action matters. Not dramatic action, necessarily. More like showing up when you said you would. Asking the question instead of guessing. Helping with the thing that has been sitting there too long. Making it clear, through behavior, that the other person is not dealing with everything alone.

When this works, both people feel a little more willing to engage. One person says what they want, and the other has something to respond to. One person makes a move, and the connection gets warmer. The care becomes easier to trust because it is not only talked about. It is shown.

The hard part is letting it stay too quiet. You may both feel the pull, but wait for the other person to make it obvious. You may care, but not say much. You may want closeness, but keep acting casual. Then the connection stays smaller than it has to.

Do not just sit on the feeling. Say it, show it, reach for it. This one gets stronger when someone gives the warmth something real to do.
